purpose: Ordinary external Game/Application lifecycle and fixed-step authoring without scanning the installed SDK.
read_policy: Use these contracts first. Open only the named exact header or canonical example when a missing signature or behavior still needs confirmation.

contracts.summary: Derive a caller-owned game. OnFixedUpdate(GameContext&, const FixedUpdate&) is required; OnStart(GameContext&) and OnStop(GameContext&) are optional.
Fixed-step callback context. Scene(), Input(), Actions(), and Ui() expose the ordinary gameplay authorities.
Authoritative fixed-step input with frame, simulationTime, and fixedDelta.

Construct with Game&, or with Game& plus caller-owned ComponentRegistry& when custom typed components are used. Start(), StepFrames(), ApplyInput()/ScheduleInput(), Present(), and Stop() are the explicit host lifecycle.
